messages:
ana: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up thread for security Q&A items we didn’t finish during the all-hands. Drop concise questions and we’ll update.

mike: Timeline question: when will SOC2 Type 2 be ready? Customers keep asking.

sarah: We have Type 1 evidence collected and posted. Type 2 target is end of Q3 pending evidence ingestion and a small remediation backlog.

pranav: Adding: ISO 27001 is next on the roadmap after SOC2 Type 2; estimating within two quarters after Type 2 completion but no firm date yet.

devon: Are there blockers that prevent auditors from starting Type 2 now?

sarah: Main blockers are consistent audit log retention across Dedicated/Private and a finalized BYOK rotation runbook. We can, however, assemble interim evidence packages for priority customers.

lucy: For Private/VPC customers: can they get audit logs into their SIEM today? PrivateLink + export options?

pranav: We provide S3-based audit exports for Hosted and Dedicated. Private package supports pushing to customer VPC via syslog or Kinesis. Docs for exact paths and ACLs are being finalized.

ana: ana: @pranav please drop the docs link here when ready.

pranav: Draft posted internally: https://intranet.redwood/security/audit-exports. Quick example for pulling from our S3 export: 

```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-exports/ORG123/2026-03-20.gz ./logs.gz
zcat logs.gz | jq -c '.event'
```

mike: KMS BYOK: can customers rotate keys themselves or do we enforce a joint rotation window?

security-bot: Reminder: by default Redwood manages CMKs. BYOK customers may bring their own CMK via KMS external key ID or HSM import. See KB.

pranav: We support customer-initiated rotation using a handshake: update the key ARN, we migrate cached keys for a 24h window. Runbook will be published this week.

devon: For HSM/BYOQ evidence — do we have artifacts auditors can see?

sarah: Yes. Private package HSM PoV has been validated; evidence (config screenshots, KMS policy diffs) is in the compliance repo under /evidence/hsm-pov-2026. Ops will produce a checklist for auditor review.

lucy: Audit log retention tiers? Customers ask 1 year vs 3 years.

pranav: Hosted default is 90 days. Dedicated configurable up to 365 days. Private is customer-managed and can be 3+ years depending on storage and contracts. Extended retention is an enterprise add-on.

ana: ana: Can we include Console dashboard exports as part of continuous monitoring evidence?

security-bot: Yes. Console supports exporting dashboard snapshots as PDF/CSV including token-level latency and alert history. Use the export button on each dashboard.

mike: ETA on the runbook and audit export doc so PM/sales can share?

pranav: Runbook draft by EOD Friday. Expanded audit-export docs into the compliance drive by Monday. I will ping here with links.

devon: Need a fallback plan if a rotation fails during the 24h window.

pranav: Fallback: previous key remains active for 7 days for rollback. After successful migration, an automated deprecate job will run. Details in runbook.

lucy: Sales need a one-pager (keys, retention, exports, cert ETAs) under 1 page to send to prospects. Can Security ops produce?

ana: ana: @sarah @pranav please produce a bullet one-pager by Monday noon for GTM.

sarah: Will do and share a link.

ops-bot: Task created: SECURITY-4321 to track runbook + docs + sales one-pager. Assignee: pranav. Due: 2026-03-30.

mike: Are admin KMS actions logged in audit exports? Need assurance for auditors.

pranav: Yes. Admin KMS events are logged with action, timestamp, actor, and resource ARN. Sensitive fields are redacted. Sample export line: 

```json
{"time":"2026-03-20T10:12:34Z","actor":"admin@example.com","action":"kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion","resource":"arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/abc123","result":"success"}
```

devon: Any SLA changes while we roll out these features? Customers concerned about availability during migrations.

ana: ana: No SLA change. We will announce maintenance windows and use rolling migrations with fallbacks; traffic may route to compatible model variants if a region is affected.

mike: I will follow up with a few customer-specific asks after this thread.

pranav: Thanks all. I will post the runbook link and one-pager here when ready.

ana: Closing thread 1 1 appreciate the quick responses. :thumbsup:
